name: flammability_hotspot_slot
description: Test 8, derived by hand from 11.1 (GetFlammabilityHotspot): the hotspot with the largest weight (strictly larger wins, so the first of equal weights; weights must be > 0); v = the adjusted value at it; an empty list or v = 0 gives false and writes nothing (the op returns false); otherwise (v, S * x, S * z) with S = 1. Hotspots [(5,5,40), (20,20,45)]: adjusted (20,20) = 0 -> false even though (5,5) is 70; adjusted (20,20) = 90 -> (90, 20, 20); equal weights [(5,5,45), (20,20,45)] -> the first, (70, 5, 5); weights 0 and -3 only -> false.
